## Summary

I investigated ticket T-3008 regarding the stuck clickhouse replica and identified the root cause: the clickhouse-2 pod cannot mount its volume because the storage array `cv-array-02` has reached the maximum LUN mappings (512) for the host initiator. This is a storage infrastructure limit that requires the storage team to clean up existing mappings. I've escalated the ticket accordingly for human engineering team to coordinate with storage administration.
